The advisory fix is minimatch 11.0.1, a major release from the 10.x copies shipped under edgemicro node_modules. Replacing every nested minimatch directory with 11.x bypasses npm semver compatibility and is not a safe catalog remediation. Adoption is pending an upstream edgemicro dependency update or a validated major migration with gateway runtime testing.

The fixed release is minimatch 11.0.1, a major version jump from 10.2.5; no 10.x release contains the fix. In this image the vulnerable copy is bundled only in the assistantDashboards plugin node_modules tree. Moving it across the major version has not been adopted yet, so this finding remains open until that plugin tree can take a validated 11.x line.

GitHub advisory and Scout document CVE-2026-118764 for npm minimatch versions below 11.0.1. Pinning minimatch to 11.0.1 via pnpm.overrides clears the advisory but breaks the HashiCorp Vault Ember UI build (broccoli SourceMapConcat fails with matcher.matchOne is not a function). Vault 2.2.x UI tooling still resolves minimatch 3.x in the lockfile used for SBOM generation; a safe override strategy is pending upstream Ember or Vault UI dependency updates.

The fix for CVE-2026-118764 is minimatch 11.0.1. No 10.x or 3.x release contains the fix, so the 10.2.x copies in Uptime Kuma 2.x and the 3.1.5 copy in Uptime Kuma 1.x are not remediable without a semver-major upgrade. Both lines pin minimatch as transitive dependencies of their npm trees. Adopting minimatch 11.x is a major-version change with breaking-change risk, so it is deferred. Reachability of the amplification path in the shipped runtime is under assessment; this statement will be revisited when the major upgrade is evaluated.
